source.patch:
From 6e9a697bd9a76475d2d947fb1a371e8f7a6edb32 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Khaled Hosny <khaled@aliftype.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2021 16:32:00 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] [graphite] Zero-initialize the decompressed buffer

Apparently lz4 is not fully initializing it despite claiming the
decompressed size is exactly what we requested.
---
 src/glat.cc                                    |   2 +-
 src/silf.cc                                    |   2 +-
 ...e77a0231fe3d0af9875d314c4c5da04e65b3680.ttf | Bin 0 -> 424652 bytes
 3 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 tests/fonts/fuzzing/1e77a0231fe3d0af9875d314c4c5da04e65b3680.ttf

diff --git a/src/glat.cc b/src/glat.cc
index 0e55cc0..d9034e1 100644
--- a/src/glat.cc
+++ b/src/glat.cc
@@ -214,7 +214,7 @@ bool OpenTypeGLAT_v3::Parse(const uint8_t* data, size_t length,
                             OTS_MAX_DECOMPRESSED_TABLE_SIZE / (1024.0 * 1024.0),
                             decompressed_size / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
       }
-      std::unique_ptr<uint8_t> decompressed(new uint8_t[decompressed_size]);
+      std::unique_ptr<uint8_t> decompressed(new uint8_t[decompressed_size]());
       int ret = LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(
           reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data + table.offset()),
           reinterpret_cast<char*>(decompressed.get()),
